findings.title: Progress Patches 10.0 CVSS WS_FTP Server Flaw CVE-2026-84295 and 14 Other Bugs
findings.summary_md: SecurityOnline.info reported the Progress Software advisory covering 15 WS_FTP Server vulnerabilities, naming the CVSS 10.0 authentication-bypass CVE-2026-84295 and the CVSS 9.9 command-injection CVE-2026-90868. The article describes versions prior to 2024.0.6 and 2025.0.3 as affected on Windows.

findings.title: CVE-2026-84295 Progress WS_FTP Server improper authentication
findings.summary_md: VulDB records the advisory disclosure date for CVE-2026-84295 as 2026-10-29, lists the upgrade target as WS_FTP Server 2024.0.6 / 2025.0.3, and notes the CVE was reserved 2026-09-01, disclosed 2026-10-29.

findings.title: CVE-2026-84295: WS_FTP Server Authentication Bypass (CVSS 10)
findings.summary_md: Strix AI's CVE entry for CVE-2026-84295 confirms improper authentication in Progress Software WS_FTP Server versions prior to 2024.0.6 and 2025.0.3 on Windows, allowing an unauthenticated remote attacker to access sensitive information.
